name: f_md5_uuid_vs_oracle_rating_result_ids
source_sql: SELECT period_id AS input, id AS oracle_id FROM ow_billing_fed.ow_billing.rating_results ORDER BY period_id
target_sql: SELECT input AS input, billing.f_md5_uuid(input) AS oracle_id FROM billing.md5_parity_input WHERE vector = 'rating_result' ORDER BY input

name: f_md5_uuid_vs_oracle_invoice_ids
source_sql: SELECT period_id || 'invoice' AS input, id AS oracle_id FROM ow_billing_fed.ow_billing.invoices ORDER BY input
target_sql: SELECT input AS input, billing.f_md5_uuid(input) AS oracle_id FROM billing.md5_parity_input WHERE vector = 'invoice' ORDER BY input

name: f_md5_uuid_vs_oracle_invoice_line_ids
source_sql: SELECT invoice_id || CAST(line_no AS STRING) AS input, id AS oracle_id FROM ow_billing_fed.ow_billing.invoice_lines ORDER BY input
target_sql: SELECT input AS input, billing.f_md5_uuid(input) AS oracle_id FROM billing.md5_parity_input WHERE vector = 'invoice_line' ORDER BY input
